acceptance_predicates.description: A new user can clone, accept/select dev, configure provider/model and agents, run workloads, record, replay offline, compare, and analyze.
The release receipt includes channel, source/build identity, provider/model selection, network boundary, and analysis output.
Interactive claims use a controlling PTY and host limitations are explicitly classified.

definition_of_done: The channel-aware quickstart and release gate pass at exact paired heads.
Independent review confirms no hidden auth or signature prerequisite.

inputs.description: Exact product heads and disposable quickstart environment.

gates.description: Fresh-user journey completes with honest PTY and offline evidence.
